text_block_list.text:
While out with Biwa Hayahide, after 
walking together for a while—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"We've walked quite a distance. You must 
be tired, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We still have some time left. Why don't we 
stop for some tea and take a break on the 
way back?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then. I frequent a coffee 
shop near here, so let me lead the way.

Since that was the case, I decided to 
follow Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The destination shop should be just past 
that corner—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That's strange.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The shop's shutters are down. It used to 
be open at this hour, though...
choice_data_list: Are they temporarily closed or something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You might be right. Shall we try a 
different place today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, a new open-air cafe 
should have opened on this street 
recently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I've never been there myself either. 
Shall we take this opportunity to go?"

Our destination turned out to be a stylish 
cafe advertised as 'Run by a Famous 
Barista.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, run by a famous barista? No wonder 
the menu is so elaborate.

Just as she said, there are dozens of 
types of drinks alone. On top of that, all 
the desserts are colorful and seem like 
they'd be popular with young girls.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's the exact opposite of the places I 
usually go, but it's perfect for hanging 
out with friends.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I should go ahead and add it to the list.

With a practiced hand, Biwa Hayahide jots 
down the shop name written on the napkin.
choice_data_list:
Do you come to cafes and coffee shops 
often?

Do you come to cafes and coffee shops 
often?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I sometimes come with friends, but I 
also enjoy coming alone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Rainy days are just perfect for reading a 
book.
choice_data_list:
Let me know if you have any other shop 
recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Rainy days are just perfect for reading a 
book.
choice_data_list:
Let me know if you have any other shop 
recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing, really. I was just looking 
for a place to read, and it somehow turned 
into a habit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Speaking of books, there's one 
I'd recommend lately.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was a work where a certain legendary 
Umamusume recounted her magnificent life 
story—

—With completely effortless motion, Biwa 
Hayahide pulled a book out of her bag.
choice_data_list: Do you always carry books around with you?
Do you always carry books with you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Now that e-books are so 
widespread, it might be rare, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's become a habit, but having a 
book in my bag always puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Now, to get back to what we were 
talking about earlier, this book truly is 
fascinating—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There should be plenty to gain from your 
perspective too. Would you like to read it 
if you're interested?

Afterward, I enjoyed reading together with 
Biwa Hayahide—

I came to understand firsthand why her 
intellect is polished day after day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Before I make a recommendation, let me 
hear a few of your conditions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whether it will be used on weekdays 
or weekends, and whether the time frame 
will be morning, afternoon, or night.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"How many people will be using it? Is the 
purpose for food, or drinks?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And then there's the location, as well as 
the desired travel time to get there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The more details you provide, the better 
the recommendations I can offer for 
suitable shops.

I thought she sounded just like a real 
estate agent, but—

Using her innate wealth of knowledge and 
analytical prowess, Biwa Hayahide 
recommended the perfect shop.
